creative_direction: Build a palm-sized ceramic landscape sculpture from overlapping rounded hills surrounding one tiny arched dwelling. The whole object should read as a single compact white form, with the dark doorway near its center. Use satin porcelain glaze on the hills and a few unglazed chalky recesses to differentiate surfaces. Include small carved steps, shallow windows, and subtle kiln speckles, keeping the details subordinate to the silhouette. Light it in a neutral studio on pale stone. Avoid a literal miniature city, text, figurines, or bright toy colors. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
